title: feat(app-shell): Studio navigation details — Advanced keeps its name, a searchable Automations rail, Create app opens Interfaces (objectui#11794)
body:
Part of #11794

Clause-②: no

Three of the card's five claimed findings are built here: the *Advanced* trigger keeps its name, the Automations rail is searchable and stops truncating names, and *Create app* opens Interfaces. Two findings and one half of a third are held. Each one needs a ruling or a new key, and the **Held** section below names what. Implemented by the `os-dev` session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01MgfduSkFrfM3eorB3UGfAU` (claim comment 6074378305).

## The five findings, re-measured on `main` `6694abe75` before any edit

| # | Finding | On `main` | Here |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | *More* holds only *Access* | **holds**: `OVERFLOW_PILLARS` has one entry (`access`), and the More popover renders that list and nothing else | held, see below |
| 2 | *Advanced* trigger renames itself | **holds**: with a power panel open, the trigger rendered `activeAdvancedTab.label` instead of "Advanced" | built |
| 3 | Automations list: no search, names cut | **holds**: the rail had no input, and each row's label sat in a `truncate` span in the `w-52` rail | search and wrap built, grouping held |
| 4 | After *Create app*, Studio stays on Data | **holds**: `doCreateApp` saved, toasted, closed the dialog and bumped the draft nonce. It did not navigate | built |
| 5 | Silent redirect without Studio access | **holds**: `RequireStudioAccess` (`apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx`) answers a non-holder with a `Navigate` to the home path (`replace`), with no state and no message | held, see below |

## What changed (`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`)

- **Advanced keeps its name.** The trigger always reads *Advanced*. It still takes the active pill (`aria-pressed`) while one of its panels is open. Its items are now `DropdownMenuRadioItem`s in a `DropdownMenuRadioGroup` whose value is the open panel, so the menu checks that panel (`aria-checked`). Each item still selects through its own `onSelect`, as the plain items did.
- **Automations rail search.** A search box sits under the rail heading. It matches the label or the machine name, case-insensitively, after a trim. The heading, New and the search box stay fixed while the list scrolls, the same layout as the Data pillar's object rail. A search that matches nothing shows the existing `engine.list.emptyQuery` line, and the empty-package line still means an empty package. Placeholder: the existing `engine.studio.designer.search` ("Search…", in en and zh). **No new key.**
- **Names wrap.** A row's label is `min-w-0 flex-1 break-words` instead of `truncate`.
- **Create app opens Interfaces.** After the unchanged draft save, the surface navigates to `/studio/PACKAGE/interfaces` unless it is already there. The navigation passes through `confirmLeavePillar`, the guard a pillar link uses. If the pillar being left holds an unsent edit, the surface asks first, and choosing to stay keeps the author there with the app already created.

H2 (no write path changes) holds: the create's one write, `save('app', NAME, buildAppSkeleton(...), { mode: 'draft', packageId })`, is pinned byte for byte in every leg of the new create-app suite. The tab, search and navigation changes write nothing.

## Held: each needs a ruling or a key

**Item 1: *Access* as a top-level tab. This contradicts a standing maintainer ruling.** objectui#5813 (2026-08-24) item 3, verbatim apart from its bold markers:

> 权限降级：从第四支柱降入顶栏「更多」菜单（页面本身不变，只动导航层级）。一级导航 4→3，与 Data/Automations/Interfaces 心智完全对齐。

The code comment on `OVERFLOW_PILLARS` cites the same ruling. Triage comment 6043000484 takes option A and routes the card out of the decision box ("no contract or product question is open"), but it does not cite objectui#5813, and a seat direction does not overrule a maintainer ruling. One measurement for that decision: the pillar row has four controls either way (Data · Automations · Interfaces · More, or Data · Automations · Interfaces · Access). The demotion therefore buys the "three maker pillars" model and costs one extra click. It does not reduce the count of controls. The options and a recommendation are in the dev report on the card.

**Item 3, grouping half: the list carries neither trigger kind nor object.**
- `loadPackageSurfaces` yields only `type`, `name` and `label`, and a draft header carries only a name.
- The `GET /api/v1/automation/_status` rows carry `triggerType` and `object`, but only for flows the engine holds. Draft-only flows have neither.
- No string names a trigger kind in English: `translateFlowMeta('type', …)` returns the raw token (`record_change`) outside zh.

Grouping would need the producer to carry the kind for draft rows, plus new engine strings (en and zh) for the group headings. Both are outside this claim's surface.

**Item 5: no existing key says that Studio access is needed.** Checked candidates:
- `capability.label.studio_access` is a label ("Studio Access"), not a sentence.
- `errors.forbidden` is "Access denied.", with no subject.
- `home.build.noCapability` names "Manage Metadata", the wrong capability.
- `empty.appAccessDenied` is about an app.

Item 5 needs one new `packages/i18n` key in all ten packs. The claim routes that as `Clause-②`, so it stops here. The guard file is unchanged.

  - `AutomationsPillar.railSearch-11794.test.tsx` (5)

- **Existing suites adjusted:**
  - `StudioDesignSurface.servedDraftTakenAsIs-10765` and `DataPillar.hiddenSystemFields-11780` now find *Settings* as a `menuitemradio`.
  - The four DataPillar suites that render the menu as passthroughs (`celGate`, `panelGate`, `designerRegistryPopulated`, `inspectorBelongsToView-11781`) mock the two radio parts the way they already mock the item.
- **Union:** every test file under `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/`, plus `StudioRoute.*`, `registerStudioComponents.builderLazy-11798`, `App.uploadAltitude-10131`, `homeRecoveryRedirectsFollowDeclaration-7373`, `builtinDesigners.lateArrival-11939`, `observableRegistries-11939`, `spec-symbol-ledger-app-shell-7265`, `HomePage.aiStudioDisabled`, `column-identity.ratchet` and `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273`. Four batches, all `Test Files … passed`: 37/37, 35/35, 45/45 and 59/59 files; 1,321 tests.
- **Ablations**, one mutation per fix, each landed and restored by `ablation-replace` with blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - the trigger renames again: 2 of 3 red; the control stays green.
  - the search filters nothing: 3 of 5 red.
  - `truncate` restored: 1 of 5 red.
  - the navigation is disabled: 3 of 4 red; the from-Interfaces control stays green.
- **Gates:**
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exits 0. Its `tsconfig.test.json` lists all ten touched test files.
  - `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new) and `check:control-bytes` pass.
  - `check:i18n-keys` passes: every in-scope key resolves.
  - `eslint` on the touched files: 0 errors.
- **First-load bytes** (`apps/console`, `CI=true vite build`, `eagerGzipBytes`): base `6694abe75` 3,238,198, head 3,238,234, so **+36 B gzip** (ceiling 3,281,467). `ui-components` +42 and `vendor-radix` +62 (the radio menu parts are now kept), and other chunks moved by a few bytes each.

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/guide/console.md`, section "Object design (Studio Data tab)", still describes a seven-tab strip (stale since objectui#5813). The docs-driven rule would also want the rail search and the create-app landing written there. This claim's file surface does not include docs, so the docs are not edited here. Carrier: none.
- The *More* trigger renames itself to "Access" while Access is open, the same pattern as item 2. It is left alone because item 1's answer decides whether *More* exists at all.
- `eslint` warnings: the four new mock lines in `DataPillar.celGate` and `DataPillar.panelGate` follow those files' existing `(p: any)` passthrough style. No warning falls inside a changed hunk of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`.
